source.publisher: Parker English 怕渴英文（TOEIC 聽力模擬試題）
source.note: 英文逐字稿取自 YouTube 字幕；中文為學習用翻譯。版權屬原作者，僅供個人學習。

lines.en: 1. Please help yourself to some refreshments.
(A) Some basic requirements.
(B) Thanks, they look very appetizing.
(C) It wasn't quite helpful.
2. What do you suggest we do with the extra income?
lines.zh: 2. 你建議我們怎麼運用這筆額外收入？

lines.en: (A) I bought some extra materials.
(B) Don't let the guests come in yet.
(C) I would invest in stocks.
3. Did your copy machine break down again?
(A) Yeah, we can talk about it at break.
(B) Yes, it stopped working an hour ago.
lines.zh: (B) 是的，一小時前就不動了。

lines.en: (C) I appreciate it.
4. This 3D printer has a warranty, doesn't it?
lines.zh: 4. 這台 3D 印表機有保固，對吧？

lines.en: (A) I was told it has a lifetime one.
(B) He doesn't have it at all.
(C) It is guaranteed free of preservatives.
5. How do I log on to this computer?
(A) Building B.
(B) Let me help you.
(C) To reduce the effects of jet lag.
6. Isn't the meeting on the second floor?
(A) No, they haven't met each other.
(B) Department heads sit in the front.
(C) Yes, that's where it usually is.
7. Didn't we visit this church last time?
lines.zh: 7. 我們上次不是參觀過這間教堂嗎？

lines.en: (A) About 25 visitors.
(B) We haven't seen this one yet.
(C) This bus goes to our destination.
lines.zh: (C) 這班公車開往我們的目的地。

lines.en: 8. What did you think of the opera?
lines.zh: 8. 你覺得那齣歌劇怎麼樣？

lines.en: (A) I think the operator could be more efficient.
lines.zh: (A) 我覺得接線員可以更有效率。

lines.en: (B) In full cooperation with the theater.
(C) I liked the set and the costumes.
lines.zh: (C) 我喜歡舞台布景和服裝。

lines.en: 9. You've already processed the refund, right?
lines.zh: 9. 你已經處理好退款了吧？

lines.en: (A) Yes, I did it early this morning.
lines.zh: (A) 是的，今天一早就處理了。

lines.en: (B) Yes, the word processing program.
(C) We're still underfunded.
10. Who was selected as the keynote speaker for this year's interior design convention?
lines.zh: 10. 今年室內設計大會選了誰當主講人？

lines.en: (A) I guess Rebecca has the key.
lines.zh: (A) 我想鑰匙在 Rebecca 那裡。

lines.en: (B) There was a great turnout at the convention.
(C) Ms. Roper, according to the newsletter.
lines.zh: (C) 根據電子報，是 Roper 女士。

lines.en: 11. How do I get into the office building on the weekend?
lines.zh: 11. 週末要怎麼進辦公大樓？

lines.en: (A) The conference room will be occupied then.
(B) Turn off the lights before you leave.
(C) Scan your ID badge at the door.
12. Where would you like to meet to review this financial report together?
lines.zh: 12. 你想在哪裡碰面一起看這份財務報告？

lines.en: (A) In the cabinet by the copier.
(B) I'll drop by your office later.
lines.zh: (B) 我晚點去你辦公室找你。

lines.en: (C) Two blocks away from here.
13. Do you know who will be leading the training session today?
lines.zh: 13. 你知道今天的訓練課程由誰主持嗎？

lines.en: (A) It'll be in the main conference room.
(B) About our hiring practices.
(C) Isaac Murphy.
14. Why do you insist on taking the subway for commuting?
lines.zh: 14. 你為什麼堅持搭地鐵通勤？

lines.en: (A) I am planning to go there by cab.
(B) Because the community center is under construction.
lines.zh: (B) 因為社區中心正在施工。

lines.en: (C) Since it's cheaper and faster.
lines.zh: (C) 因為比較便宜又比較快。

lines.en: 15. You ordered more parts for the motor, right?
lines.zh: 15. 你有多訂一些馬達零件，對吧？

lines.en: (A) Thanks, it's a new model.
(B) Yes, last week.
(C) Yes, he was promoted.
16. How did you get to be so good on the violin?
lines.zh: 16. 你小提琴怎麼拉得這麼好？

lines.en: (A) The play was way better than expected.
(B) By a top-notch violinist from England.
lines.zh: (B) 由一位來自英國的頂尖小提琴家。

lines.en: (C) I used to major in performing arts.
17. Do you prefer the current edition of the flyer or the original one?
lines.zh: 17. 傳單你比較喜歡現在的版本還是原本的？

lines.en: (A) I like the smaller one.
(B) Please print five of them.
(C) My flight leaves this evening.
18. Did you get the customs declaration card?
lines.zh: 18. 你拿到海關申報單了嗎？

lines.en: (A) It's custom-made.
(B) Yes, I will pay with my credit card.
(C) Yes, but they gave me the Japanese version.
lines.zh: (C) 拿到了，但他們給我的是日文版。

lines.en: 19. Why don't we finish discussing this after lunch?
lines.zh: 19. 我們午餐後再把這個討論完如何？

lines.en: (A) No, just a chicken sandwich.
lines.zh: (A) 不用，一份雞肉三明治就好。

lines.en: (B) They're on the third floor.
(C) Sure, I'll come back then.
20. Has Mr. Kingsley decided to allow the pay cuts or offer early retirement to the employees as part of the restructuring?
lines.zh: 20. Kingsley 先生決定好了嗎？重整要用減薪，還是讓員工提前退休？

lines.en: (A) Too bad that the company went bankrupt.
(B) He hasn't made up his mind yet.
(C) He didn't allow us to fire anyone.
lines.zh: (C) 他不准我們開除任何人。
